description: Takes chat comments as input to move the player

mods.name: Twitch Plays MC
mods.description: Takes chat comments as button inputs to move the player

releases.notes:
Tested on fabric 1.15.1 and  fabric 19w46b so it *should* work between those versions

## InGame Commands
```
/tpmc            -> displays the current channel, the "play" flag and the pressDuration value
/tpmc <channel>  -> connects to the given twitch channel and logs the comments
/tpmc disconnect -> disconnects from the twitch channel
/tpmc play       -> lets the chat take over your player's movement
/tpmc stop       -> stops that ^
/tpmc pressDuration <milliseconds> -> change how long the keys will be pressed per action (400 by default)
```
## Chat Commands
When ``/tpmc play`` is enabled, the mod will take comments with only 1 character as commands:
```
W,A,S,D -> press their respective keys for as long as you set <pressDuration>
J       -> jumps
```
